dedupe_keys.name: amenagements cyclables de l ouest cornouaille

description: Amenagements cyclables de l'Ouest Cornouaille is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Michael Häusle. This dataset contains all cycling facilities in the broad sense in use at the time the data was created. Coverage: Michael Häusle. The portal shows the English title as "Western Cornwall Cycling Facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Michael Häusle. Its keywords include bande cyclable, Ouest Cornouaille, données ouvertes, vélo, Pays Bigouden Sud, Douarnenez Communauté. The listing shows 2020-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
